environment.description: Kubernetes pod in namespace 'iot-staging' on same EKS cluster. Namespace has a NetworkPolicy with spec.podSelector matching all pods (empty selector), spec.policyTypes including 'Egress', and spec.egress containing a single rule allowing TCP port 53 (DNS) to kube-dns and TCP 443 to CIDR 10.0.0.0/8 only. The policy implicitly denies all other egress including link-local 169.254.0.0/16. Additionally, a secondary NetworkPolicy 'deny-metadata' with spec.egress explicitly containing an ipBlock with cidr 0.0.0.0/0 and except [169.254.169.254/32] is applied but this is redundant given the first policy's allowlist approach. Service exposed via ClusterIP only, accessible through nginx ingress controller with connection rate limit of 5 req/s per source IP (nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/limit-connections: '5').
